'''Arent son of [[Halan]]''' is an [[Ogier]] [[Elder]] of [[Stedding Shangtai|''Stedding'' Shangtai]] and father of [[Loial]].

==History==
Elder Arent learned that his son, Loial, has a [[Talent]] for [[Treesinging]]. Arent demands that his son learn this ability to the fullest extent.{{ref/book|1|42}} Like many of the other Elders of the Ogier, he often speaks of his visit with the [[Someshta|Green Man]].{{ref/book|1|46}}
